description:
Fill-in-the-middle code completion with Codestral.

Given `prompt` (code preceding the cursor) and `suffix` (code after the cursor),
Codestral writes the middle. Use for editor autocomplete scenarios, code-patching
agents, or structured refactors where you know the target boundaries.

Default stop tokens: [] — let the model decide. Override with `stop` if needed.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Input tokens plus this limit must fit within the model's context length.

model.description: FIM (fill-in-the-middle) model identifier. Any identifier your endpoint serves is accepted — read mistral://models for the live catalog. Known Mistral aliases: codestral-latest.

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic sampling. Maps to Mistral's `random_seed`.

stop.description: Stop generation when any of these text sequences is encountered.

suffix.description: Code after the cursor. Can be empty string.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature: higher values make output more random; lower values make it more focused. Prefer adjusting this or top_p, not both.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability mass: 0.1 considers tokens in the top 10% of probability mass. Prefer adjusting this or temperature, not both.

name: codestral_fim
title: Codestral fill-in-the-middle completion
